agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting - Audio only - no video - DVD available in the City Clerk's Department
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 8, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Bill Record, Member of the Community
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring March 9, 2011, "Vista Pop Warner Puma Cheer Squad Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation to Kelly Matthews of North County Lifeline declaring April 2011 "Fair Housing Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Ambulance Billing Contract Extension (CC)
C4.
As-Needed Agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering (CC/BSD)
C5.
As-Needed Engineering Surveying Services Agreements (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc. for as-needed engineering surveying services;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with Melchior Land Surveying, Inc. for as-needed engineering surveying services;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with O'Day Consultants, Inc., for as-needed engineering surveying services; and
4.
Authorize the Mayor to execute the three agreements.
C6.
Caltrans Bicycle Transportation Account Grant (CC)
C7.
Regional Incident Support Unit Purchase (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the purchase of a Regional Incident Support Unit (ISU); and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the Interlocal Contract for Cooperative Purchasing with Houston-Galvaston Area Council (H-GAC).
C8.
SDSO Smart Start Special Event Banner (CC)
C9.
Interim Public Works Director Employment Agreement (CC)
C10.
Recreation and Community Services Field Rental Fees (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
2010 Regional Transportation Improvement Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , adopting an amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2011 through 2015.
SPECIAL CONSOLIDATED MEETING
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
